question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a purple present, Bob has a red present, Claire has a gold present, Dave has a green present, Eve has a black present, Fred has a blue present, and Gertrude has a white present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Gertrude swap their gifts. Finally, Dave and Alice swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Eve has the
Options:
(A) purple present
(B) red present
(C) gold present
(D) green present
(E) black present
(F) blue present
(G) white present
solution:
Present colors in Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude order:
Initial: purple, red, gold, green, black, blue, white
After Bob–Dave: purple, green, gold, red, black, blue, white
After Dave–Claire: purple, green, red, gold, black, blue, white
After Alice–Bob: green, purple, red, gold, black, blue, white
After Claire–Dave: green, purple, gold, red, black, blue, white
After Dave–Fred: green, purple, gold, blue, black, red, white
After Fred–Gertrude: green, purple, gold, blue, black, white, red
After Dave–Alice: blue, purple, gold, green, black, white, red
Eve has the black present, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
